# Getting started with R

This chapter covers the software and data used in the manual. The examples use R; no Python setup is required to build or follow the manual.

## Install R

Install the current version of R from [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/). Choose a mirror near you and follow its instructions for your operating system.

## Choose an editor

[RStudio Desktop](https://posit.co/download/rstudio-desktop/) is a free integrated development environment for writing and running R code. You can also use another R-compatible editor, such as [Positron](https://positron.posit.co/).

## Install the example data

The manual examples use the `QuantumData` package. From a checkout of this repository, install the pinned data package with:

```sh
Rscript scripts/install-quantumdata.R
```

For example, load the health-insurance data in R with:

```r
library(QuantumData)
data("health_insurance", package = "QuantumData")
str(health_insurance)
```

The complete set of R package dependencies used to build the book is listed in the repository's `DESCRIPTION` file.
